description: Builds, audits, and governs brand voice frameworks: breaks a voice into 3 to 5 scorable traits, maps how tone shifts by context, scores existing content trait by trait with quoted evidence, structures voice across parent brands, sub-brands, and acquisitions, and sets up pre-publication voice review. Use when the user wants to define or document a brand voice, adapt tone for different channels, check whether content is on-brand, audit content for voice consistency, align voices across a brand portfolio, or set up a brand voice governance process.
